ask: Require source checks and actual test evidence before claims of completion or root cause.
plugin: A Stop hook checks a structured evidence ledger and blocks unsupported completion; a review agent reruns the decisive checks and reports gaps.

ask: Ask before destructive, billable, or out-of-scope actions and honor explicit denials.
plugin: A PreToolUse hook enforces path, command, spend and publication boundaries, with an approval ledger and a scoped agent instruction.

ask: Prevent secrets and private session links from leaking into output, commits, or network calls.
plugin: PreToolUse and PostToolUse hooks scan files, command input, tool results and commit messages; deny or redact risky sends.

ask: Set cost, time, and agent-count limits before delegation and surface spending per agent.
plugin: Function hooks gate agent.spawn and model requests against a budget; a statusline displays live per-agent usage and cost.

ask: Keep concurrent agents on their assigned branches and avoid destructive cross-worktree Git operations.
plugin: A PreToolUse hook records each agent worktree and denies writes or Git commands that cross it; a command checks branch ancestry before PR work.

ask: Review proposed fixes against repository evidence and independent behavioral tests.
plugin: A specialist review agent traces callers and invariants, runs adversarial tests, and reports findings with source references.

ask: Run authorized defensive code reviews and hardening checks with clear scope and evidence.
plugin: A security audit skill and specialist agent run local static checks, threat modeling and remediation review within declared scope.

ask: Back up local transcripts and retain usable history despite cleanup, moves, or project renames.
plugin: A monitor copies JSONL and metadata into a versioned archive and a command restores or searches it.

ask: Find, identify, and address local sessions and agents across projects and entry points.
plugin: An MCP server indexes local session metadata and exposes safe list, search, send and rename tools.

ask: Carry relevant memory across sessions while retaining source and freshness checks.
plugin: An MCP memory store records provenance and timestamps; a SessionStart hook retrieves relevant notes and warns on stale claims.

ask: Preserve active obligations and show what changed when a long conversation compacts.
plugin: A function hook rewrites the compacted message set from a task ledger and records a visible before-and-after summary; it cannot force earlier native compaction.

ask: Load only relevant tool schemas, skill descriptions and reference files into context.
plugin: Function hooks defer tool descriptions and trim first-message context; a skill audits large references and loads them on demand.

ask: Pin or select a model and effort for a task, subagent, or budget without silent drift.
plugin: A function hook sets model and effort at turn.step and agent.spawn and alerts on a mismatch with the requested route.

ask: Keep answers in the chosen language, tone, length and review format.
plugin: An output style specifies the response contract; a Stop hook checks language and format before delivery.

ask: Detect invalid, stale, shadowed, or silently unloaded plugin components before work begins.
plugin: A bin validator checks manifests, skill frontmatter, names, versions, installed state and MCP startup; a SessionStart hook summarizes failures.

ask: Distinguish configured MCP servers from connected servers and working tools.
plugin: A command probes MCP initialization, authentication, tool listing and an inexpensive real call, with actionable diagnostics.

ask: Make optional and unusual MCP arguments reach servers in a valid form.
plugin: An MCP proxy normalizes optional, nullable and Boolean schemas and validates outbound arguments before forwarding.

ask: Watch long jobs and show progress, stalled output, errors, and orphaned child processes.
plugin: A monitor tracks process trees and task state; a statusline and notification hook expose progress and stop orphans.

ask: Check branch freshness, tests, review and explicit approval before publishing or merging.
plugin: A command performs a pre-PR evidence check; a PreToolUse hook blocks push and merge until the named conditions pass.

ask: Show current session identity, model, effort, elapsed time and per-agent cost.
plugin: A statusline command reads session and usage metadata and renders a compact configurable indicator.

ask: Make the active repository, directory and account visible before file changes or external actions.
plugin: A SessionStart hook validates cwd and repository identity, while a statusline displays the active target and a PreToolUse hook blocks mismatches.

ask: Log in during browser automation without exposing passwords in model context.
plugin: An MCP server brokers password-manager retrieval and user-approved credential entry, returning only login outcome.

ask: Use local or third-party models through a configurable routing layer.
plugin: An experimental function hook rewrites model requests and headers through a user-configured local gateway.

ask: Preview, redact and limit conversation context before feedback leaves the machine.
plugin: A function hook intercepts feedback submission, renders a review, and strips turns or secrets the user excludes.

ask: Attach durable notes or replies to a specific assistant message.
plugin: Experimental UI function hooks add an annotation action and store message-linked notes in plugin data.

ask: Adjust terminal input behavior, selection and command shortcuts.
plugin: Experimental UI function hooks intercept input, selection and key presses to implement user-configured bindings.

ask: Discuss options and clarify intent without executing or entering a formal plan.
plugin: A discussion skill instructs Claude to ask and reason before tool use; a PreToolUse hook can enforce read-only mode.

ask: Load instructions for the current task type rather than only by file path.
plugin: A SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit hook selects matching rule files and injects their text for the active task.

ask: Give every model turn an accurate local time reference.
plugin: A function hook appends the current clock time to each model request.

ask: Mark URLs created by Claude Code for analytics.
plugin: A function hook rewrites outbound answer URLs to append the configured UTM source.

ask: Track datasets, runs, metrics and reproducibility in Claude Code.
plugin: A skill guides experiment design and an MCP server records runs and metrics in a local tracker.

ask: Inspect authorized network devices and audit VLAN configuration.
plugin: An MCP server wraps local device discovery and read-only configuration APIs with an explicit target list.

ask: Generate and run scoped diagnostics for managed Macs.
plugin: A skill selects diagnostic checks and a bin executable collects local MDM and system evidence.

ask: Clock in and out from Claude Code workflows.
plugin: An MCP server exposes the time-tracking service API with confirmation before entries are written.

ask: Use Zebra scanner input from Claude Code.
plugin: A local MCP server reads the scanner SDK or HID stream and exposes scan events as tools.

ask: Create shared lists and coordinate task review.
plugin: An MCP server connects a shared task-list backend; a skill structures review and assignment steps.

ask: Bring Codex sessions into a searchable Claude Code archive.
plugin: A bin importer reads exported Codex transcripts and an MCP server searches normalized sessions.

ask: Keep plugin installs, enabled state and versions consistent across projects and worktrees.
plugin: A bin command audits installed and enabled records, validates marketplace versions, snapshots settings, and repairs mismatches with a dry run.

ask: Log agent actions and detect unusual dispatch or permission patterns.
plugin: SubagentStart, PreToolUse and Stop hooks write a local audit stream; a monitor alerts on scope or fanout anomalies.

ask: Display live Claude Code activity in a separate desktop companion.
plugin: A monitor reads session events and publishes local state for a desktop widget.

ask: Resume interrupted work after retryable API errors without losing the task checkpoint.
plugin: A StopFailure hook records the failure; a local monitor retries the session with bounded backoff and the last task checkpoint.

ask: Start a new Claude Code session on a registered host from another device.
plugin: A local monitor receives authenticated channel requests and launches a session in an approved working directory.

ask: React to local print jobs in a Claude Code workflow.
plugin: A monitor watches the print spooler and exposes job events through a local MCP server.

ask: Keep generated comments and documentation concise.
plugin: An output-style instruction sets comment density and a Stop hook flags excessive generated prose.

ask: Improve dependency update and security fix workflows.
plugin: A skill checks CI, lockfiles and dependency risk before proposing a Dependabot fix.

ask: Search the web autonomously during coding investigations.
plugin: An MCP server supplies search and fetch tools, with a research skill that cites retrieved sources.

ask: Stop corrupted non-Latin tool arguments before they alter files or external systems.
plugin: A function hook inspects tool.call arguments for malformed escapes or unexpected script changes, blocks suspect calls, and asks for a fresh value.

ask: Accept ordinary Windows line endings in file-backed workflow requests.
plugin: A function hook normalizes CRLF in workflow tool arguments before validation.

ask: Show edits made through shell commands and prefer tracked file-editing tools.
plugin: PreToolUse and PostToolUse hooks snapshot relevant files around Bash writes and present a diff and tool-choice warning.

ask: Give the agent reliable exact-file and content search when native search tools are missing.
plugin: An MCP server exposes bounded ripgrep and file-index tools with explicit ignored-file options.

ask: Render hook-supplied display content and accessible permission indicators.
plugin: Experimental UI function hooks replace affected terminal components with configurable display text and glyphs.
